title: Trustin and the Curled Leaf
introduction: Trustin and the Curled Leaf. Trustin sees a curled leaf and reaches for water. His friend notices a clue that changes their plan.

nodes.text: Trustin and the Curled Leaf. Trustin sees a curled leaf and reaches for water. His friend notices a clue that changes their plan.
Trustin wanted the leaf to look better. He lifted the watering can. His friend asked him to check the soil first.
The soil felt very wet. Trustin set down the can. More water did not seem like the right help today.
They asked the gardener to look. Water was trapped in the pot. The gardener chose another pot with holes underneath.
The gardener moved the plant carefully. Extra water could drain into a tray. Trustin helped tidy the loose soil.
Over the next few days, they checked the plant together. At last, a new leaf began to open. They kept watching.
Trustin left the watering can on its hook. Before helping again, he would look, check, and ask. The end.
